currency_assumptions: Venue prices are researched and stored in JPY (cost_local_amount / cost_local_currency = JPY). The soft budget and every USD figure use the ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates dated 2026-11-27 and fetched 2026-11-28: EUR 1 = USD 1.0957 and EUR 1 = JPY 174.81, giving USD 1 = JPY 159.5418 and 1 JPY = USD 0.00626795. See fx_evidence_2026-11-28.md for the worked cross-rate and three hand recomputations.

Where a venue publishes a 09:00-17:00 block and a longer block, the recorded amount is the published package that best covers a 09:00-17:00 day (the 8-hour block where one exists; otherwise the shortest published package that covers it, such as an all-day 09:00-21:00 rate), and the longer figure is stated inside evidence.observed_facts. Packages therefore differ in length between venues (8 h day block, 11 h all-day, 12 h all-day), so the USD figures are prices for each venue's own published package, not hour-for-hour comparisons.

Where a venue publishes only an hourly rate, the recorded amount is that rate multiplied by 8 hours, stated in evidence.observed_facts. Where no readable price exists, estimated_cost_usd is null with a cost_unknown question rather than a guessed figure.

declared_gaps.text: School-holiday coverage for Tokyo is the five JP:tokyo rows of pinned registry edition 3b20667d — 2026-12-26..2027-01-07, 2027-03-26..2027-04-05, 2027-07-21..2027-08-31, the single day 2027-10-01 and 2027-12-26..2028-01-07 — carried as the registry prints them, with no names attached to those rows. No other Tokyo school date (entrance-exam days, make-up days, ward or private-school variations) was verified, so the calendar is the rule default and not a full school-year map.

Seventeen 2027 calendar rows were merged, each organiser-confirmed in the approved bundle; the page recommends no date and none of the seventeen is booked. Declared gap: Japan Mobility Show 2027 — the organiser announces 2027-10-28..2027-11-07 at Tokyo Big Sight, the same class as the recorded CEATEC and Tokyo Game Show rows, and it is deliberately not in the array; the approved review left it for a later sweep rather than another completeness round. Unknown-date editions are also not in the array: Japan Blockchain Week 2027 (the site still shows 2026-07-01..15), PyCon JP 2027, ETHGlobal Tokyo and IVS 2027.

Four of the sixteen rooms carry no USD figure: 田町グランパークカンファレンス 401, 渋谷ヒカリエ 8/CUBE, SHIBUYA QWS スクランブルホール and 富士ソフト アキバプラザ セミナールーム1. Their operator pages publish the fee only as a PDF or not at all, so the cost is unknown rather than zero, and each record carries a confirm-cost question.

Each of the sixteen room records rests on a single operator or city page for its capacity, rate, hours and equipment; no second independent source was found for any room, and the record dates say so. All sixteen records are marked needs_human_verify.

Eight of the sixteen rooms carry no room photograph: 新宿アイタウン会議室, 浅草橋ヒューリック ROOM 2, 東京国際フォーラム 会議室 G402, 品川インターシティ 貸会議室5 and 貸会議室1+2, 東京虎ノ門グローバルスクエア Room A+B, TKP新宿 カンファレンスルーム4C and ベルサール六本木 Room C. The captured operator pages print rate tables, layouts, scene illustrations, building exteriors or uncaptioned images, so a withheld record with that reason is stored instead of an exterior, a look-alike or a stock image. No Wikimedia image was used: no Commons file on a captured page depicts one of these hired rooms.

The three local-requirement claims record the Tokyo-level and national rules for language, alcohol and food. They do not say which licence a given venue holds, whether a 50-person private event is covered, or who would hold it: alcohol service and external catering stay unknown on every room, and one room (品川インターシティ 貸会議室5) is described by its operator as alcohol-permitted only as a room fact.

Eleven of the sixteen rows carry a published window that covers the 8-hour 09:00-17:00 programme and supports a closing at 18:00 (allows_to_6); the other five are unknown because their operator pages publish no hire window. No room publishes a covered 09:00-21:00 hire interval, so the 12-hour preferred programme is confirmed nowhere and the 8-hour floor is the only window the evidence supports.

The five programme-wide mandatory discovery sources (Miragather x3, AI Tinkerers, the DeAI Luma feed) carry no check date in this store: the Tokyo research bundle did not record them, and the page prints that fact rather than an assumed read.

All sixteen records are building tier: the point is the building that houses the room, taken from the saved GSI address-search response for the block address, and no room entrance was verified. The two 品川インターシティ rooms share one address and therefore one point.

The page anchors the rule in 'Schulzeitgesetz 1985, BGBl. I Nr. 77/1985'; the § 2 Abs 4 Z 8 wording was read from the RIS consolidated text through the search backend's fetch because direct access to ris.bka.gv.at answers HTTP 503 from the curation host.

evidence.observed_facts: Schulzeitgesetz 1985 § 2 Abs 4 Z 3 makes 24 December to 6 January the statutory Christmas school-free period in every year; in 2027/28 that is Friday 24 December 2027 to Thursday 6 January 2028. The optional 23 December extension applies only when 23 December is a Monday (it is a Thursday in 2027), and no ordinance declaring 23 December 2027 or 7 January 2028 free is published, so the statutory span is recorded. The Vienna 2027/28 school-year edition is not published, so this row rests on the statute alone.

holidays.source_edition: Schulzeitgesetz 1985 § 2 Abs 4 Z 3, RIS-Fassung vom 21.10.2026
holidays.source_locator: § 2 Abs 4 Z 3: 'die Tage vom 24. Dezember bis einschließlich 6. Jänner (Weihnachtsferien); der 23. Dezember, sofern er auf einen Montag fällt; überdies können der 23. Dezember sowie der 7. Jänner, wenn es für einzelne Schulen aus Gründen der Ab- oder Anreise der Schüler zweckmäßig ist, von der zuständigen Schulbehörde durch Verordnung schulfrei erklärt werden'
holidays.source_title: Schulzeitgesetz 1985 - Bundesrecht konsolidiert, Fassung vom 21.10.2026

evidence.observed_facts: Schulzeitgesetz 1985 § 2 Abs 4 Z 2 declares 'der Allerseelentag' school-free, and the BMB page lists 'der Allerseelentag (2. November)' under 'Schulfrei sind - abgesehen von den Sonntagen -'. The date is fixed at 2 November in every year, so the 2027 occurrence is Tuesday 2 November 2027. Allerseelen is not one of Austria's statutory public holidays (the AT public layer carries the thirteen gesetzliche Feiertage and none falls on 2 November), so the day is recorded here as a school_holiday row. The Vienna directorate 2026/2027 page lists the same date in its 'Schulfreie Tage' section for 2026 ('Allerheiligen, Allerseelen: Sonntag, 1. November und Montag, 2. November 2026'), confirming that Vienna observes it. Direct access to ris.bka.gv.at from the curation host answers HTTP 503, so the wording was read through the search backend's fetch of the consolidated page https://www.ris.bka.gv.at/GeltendeFassung.wxe?Abfrage=Bundesnormen&Gesetzesnummer=10009575. That page's 'Fassung vom' header label was not stable across fetches on 2026-11-20 (21.10.2026, 18.11.2026 and 19.11.2026 were each printed by a fetch of the same URL), so this row cites the statute by Gesetzesnummer and asserts no Fassung date.

evidence.observed_facts: The school-year regulation fixes the winter Christmas break as 23–31 December in every year, with an earlier 22 December start only when 22 December is a Monday. In 2027/28 22 December is a Wednesday, so the statutory span is Thursday 23 December to Friday 31 December 2027. The full MEN 2027/2028 calendar is not published; the only 2027/2028 item on the ministry's calendar index is the winter-break announcement, which places mazowieckie on 31 January–13 February 2028, outside this window.

evidence.observed_facts: The MŠMT 2026/2027 edition prints 'Vánoční prázdniny začínají ve středu 23. prosince 2026 a končí v neděli 3. ledna 2027.' and names Monday 4 January 2027 as the day teaching resumes. The row keeps the stated full bounds although it starts before the 2027-01-01 window start. Vyhláška 16/2005 Sb. § 4 odst. 3 fixes the break as 23 December to 2 January inclusive with an end extension only when 3 January is a Friday; in 2026/27 2 January is a Saturday, so the ministry's stated Sunday end adds only the weekend day on which no teaching takes place.

東京国税局 酒税とお酒の免許に関するご質問やご相談等について

alcohol.quote: 博覧会場等で臨時に販売場を設けて酒類の小売を行う場合には、期限を付した酒類小売業免許を申請し、取得していただく必要があります。 … 期限付酒類小売業免許を受けるためには、原則として、販売場を開設する日の２週間前までに申請する必要がありますが、一定の要件を満たす場合には、販売場を開設する日の10日前までに届け出ることで、期限付酒類小売業免許を受けたものとして取り扱うこととしています。 … 博覧会場等で臨時に酒類を販売するときは、以下の判定表で各項目を御確認いただき、臨時販売場の … 酒場、料理店その他酒類を専ら自己の営業場で飲用に供する業を行う場合には、販売業免許は必要ありませんが、例えばテイクアウト用など、その営業場以外の場所で飲用に供されるための酒類を販売する場合には、酒税法に基づき、販売場ごとにその販売場の所在地の所轄税務署長から販売業免許を受ける必要があります。 … 東京都 … 麹町 、 日本橋 、 京橋 、 四谷 、 新宿 、 小石川 、 本郷 、 中野 、 杉並 、 荻窪 … 神田税務署 酒類指導官部門 … 芝 、 麻布 、 荏原 、 目黒 、 大森 、 雪谷 、 蒲田 、 世田谷 、 北沢 、 玉川 、 渋谷 … 品川税務署 酒類指導官部門 … 東京上野 、 本所 、 向島 、 江東西 、 江東東 、 足立 、 西新井 、 葛飾 、 江戸川北 、 江戸川南 … 浅草税務署 酒類指導官部門 … 王子 、 荒川 、 板橋 、 練馬東 、 練馬西 … 豊島税務署 酒類指導官部門 … 八王子 、 武蔵野 、 青梅 、 武蔵府中 、 町田 、 日野 、 東村山 … 立川税務署 酒類指導官部門

alcohol.source_title: 国税庁 期限付酒類小売業免許について; 国税庁 お酒に関するQ&A【販売業免許関係】Q3; 東京国税局 酒税とお酒の免許に関するご質問やご相談等について

value.authority: 国税庁（酒税法）; for a temporary 販売場 the licensing office is その販売場の所在地の所轄税務署長, and the 東京国税局 表2 lists five 酒類指導官 desks for 東京都 — 神田・品川・浅草・豊島・立川 — each serving the 税務署 printed on its own row, so which desk answers for a venue depends on that venue's 所轄税務署, not on a single central desk.
value.hired_room_scope: A hired hall is not the organiser's own 営業場, so the Q3 exemption does not settle alcohol at a hired venue; nothing on these three pages addresses a private event at a rented room.
value.not_established: The pages do not say whether complimentary drinks with no sale need any licence, and they set no rule for a private, invitation-only audience.
value.on_premises_rule_scope: Q3 answers only for a 酒場・料理店 that serves alcohol 専ら自己の営業場: serving it there for drinking on those premises needs no 販売業免許. Q3 itself says that selling alcohol for drinking away from those premises needs a 販売業免許 from the 所轄税務署長, one per 販売場.
value.quoted_rule_scope: 国税庁 states that setting up a temporary 販売場 at a 博覧会場等 to retail alcohol requires a 期限を付した酒類小売業免許 (期限付酒類小売業免許), applied for in principle at least two weeks before the sales point opens, or notified at least ten days before when the 要件 are met.
value.selling_needs_licence: Selling alcohol at the event — a cash or ticket bar included — is a 酒類の小売; the 国税庁 page quoted sets the 期限付酒類小売業免許 route for a temporary 販売場 at an 博覧会場・即売会場 その他これらに類する場所. Whether a private event inside a hired hall is such a place is not established by these pages.
value.tokyo_desk_mapping: 東京国税局 表2 東京都, as printed: 神田税務署 — 麹町・日本橋・京橋・四谷・新宿・小石川・本郷・中野・杉並・荻窪; 品川税務署 — 芝・麻布・荏原・目黒・大森・雪谷・蒲田・世田谷・北沢・玉川・渋谷; 浅草税務署 — 東京上野・本所・向島・江東西・江東東・足立・西新井・葛飾・江戸川北・江戸川南; 豊島税務署 — 王子・荒川・板橋・練馬東・練馬西; 立川税務署 — 八王子・武蔵野・青梅・武蔵府中・町田・日野・東村山.
value.who_must_hold_it: Not established by these pages: whether the venue, the caterer or the organiser holds the licence for a 50-person private event stays a venue-level question carried as a declared gap on every room.

food.quote: 縁日、祭礼等の行事において、簡易な施設を設けて不特定多数の方を対象として食品提供を行う場合は、臨時営業の許可申請又は臨時出店の届出が必要となります。 … 次のフローチャートを参考に、必要となる手続を確認し、 … 行事開催場所を所管する保健所へ必ず事前にご相談ください。 … Q2 行事の参加対象が特定の方に限定されている。 … 模擬店等 … 届出の手続へ … 書類は施設工事完成予定日の10日くらい前に保健所へ提出してください。 … 営業所を所管する保健所 … 令和３年６月１日から、新たな「営業の許可制度」「営業の届出制度」が始まりました！

food.source_title: 東京都保健医療局「食品衛生の窓」 営業許可・届出の概要 and 改正食品衛生法の営業許可と届出

value.authority: 東京都保健医療局 健康安全部 食品監視課 規格基準担当; the licence counter is the 保健所 that covers the premises
value.event_route: For a one-off 縁日・祭礼-style event where a simple installation serves food to an unspecified public, the city requires either a 臨時営業 licence application or a 臨時出店 notification, and tells the organiser to consult the 保健所 that covers the event venue beforehand.
value.fixed_premises: A food business at a fixed premises applies for 営業許可 to the 保健所 that covers that premises (営業所を所管する保健所), submitting documents about ten days before the planned completion of the facility works.
value.licence: 食品衛生法に基づく営業許可（飲食店営業を含む）
value.limited_audience_route: The published flowchart asks whether the event's participants are restricted to specific people; `はい` routes to the 模擬店等 届出 procedure. A 50-person private event falls in that 「参加対象が特定」 branch of the chart, not the 不特定多数 one — but the chart is a pointer to the 保健所, not a permit.
value.not_established: These pages do not say who holds the licence for a private event (caterer or organiser), whether a member-only event needs any notification at all, or what the fee and lead time are for the 模擬店等 route; those stay venue-level questions.

additional_sources.source_title: TMG English — Connecting words, connecting hearts (2020-12-03, Bureau of Citizens, Culture and Sports)

language.quote: 「やさしい日本語」とは、難しい言葉を言い換えるなど、相手に配慮したわかりやすい日本語のことです。 … 「やさしい日本語」は、日本語の持つ美しさや豊かさを軽視するものではなく、外国人、高齢者や障害のある人など、その人にあった言語調整を行い、多くの人に日本語を使ってわかりやすく伝えようとするものです。 … As of January 2020 there were 580,000 foreign nationals residing in Tokyo … Languages that foreigners residing in Japan can understand: Japanese 60%, English 40%
language.source_locator: captures/claim_language_tokyo_yasashii.html — block 「やさしい日本語とは」 (page dated 2025-10-24), second and third paragraphs of やさしい日本語とは; captures/claim_language_tokyo_simple_ja_en.html — the 2020-12-03 TMG article body (Bureau of Citizens, Culture and Sports), sentence "As of January 2020 there were 580,000 foreign nationals residing in Tokyo" and the caption "Languages that foreigners residing in Japan can understand: Japanese 60%, English 40%". Both pages were read from the saved bytes after tag stripping and whitespace normalisation, so no line numbers are asserted.
language.source_title: 東京都生活文化局「やさしい日本語（にほんご）」 (updated 2025-10-24) and TMG English article "Connecting words, connecting hearts — Preparation of a Video to Promote Simple Japanese" (2020-12-03)

value.access_implication: An event whose copy, signage and stage language are English-only reaches at most the 40% the TMG article records for English, and Japanese-only copy is not a universal fallback either; the city's own published answer is adjusted Japanese, not a single fixed language.
value.authority: 東京都 生活文化局 都民生活部 地域活動推進課 多文化共生推進担当
value.city_guidance: The city defines やさしい日本語 as Japanese made easy to understand by replacing difficult words, and says the practice adjusts the language to the person — 外国人、高齢者や障害のある人など — rather than assuming one register reaches everyone.
value.comprehension_figures: The same TMG article reports that among foreigners residing in Japan 60% can understand Japanese and 40% English, attributing the figures to a 2018 Tokyo International Communication Committee interview survey on information communication for foreigners residing in Tokyo.
value.not_established: These pages set no obligation on a private event's language, and they do not say what share of Tokyo's foreign residents understand やさしい日本語; the figures are about comprehension of Japanese and English, not of adjusted Japanese.
value.resident_profile: The Tokyo Metropolitan Government's own English article puts the number of foreign nationals residing in Tokyo at 580,000 as of January 2020.
